waypost.prompt: Create one production game sprite: a humble wooden roadside wayfinding signpost for a Joseon Korea historical fantasy overhead RPG. Transparent background. Board face is broad, uncluttered, nearly horizontal and flat enough to overlay 4 Korean characters in game. A tiny traditional warm amber paper lantern hangs from a short peg below and to the left of the arrow board using rope, and there is a small straw rope binding around the post. No roof, no gate, no magic, no portal, no circles, no people, no ground tile, no scenery. Rich hand painted crisp pixel-art texture, dark ink-like outlines, teal-gray stone shadows and warm sunset amber light, detailed wood grain matching a lush 16-bit Joseon village. Full object well inside square canvas with generous transparent margins. Silhouette roughly 70% canvas width and 80% height. Signboard at 25%-45% vertical, post to 85% vertical. Foot point center horizontally. Modest ordinary rural signpost, no modern signage.
